title: Software Engineering
intro: Eight years of building platforms that survive real users, real load, and real teams.

items.title: System & API Architecture
items.description: Designing service boundaries, data models, and REST/GraphQL APIs that stay maintainable as products grow.

items.title: Backend Platforms
items.description: Laravel, FastAPI, and Node.js backends with queues, caching layers, and background workers built for scale.

items.title: Modern Frontend
items.description: React, Next.js, and Vue applications with performance budgets, accessibility, and design-system discipline.

items.title: Data & Storage
items.description: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis — schema design, query optimization, and migration strategies.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.description: AWS deployments, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure that ships safely and rolls back cleanly.

items.title: Technical Leadership
items.description: Leading teams, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, and turning ambiguous requirements into shipped products.
